payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the previous state of the art in the context of the AI2 WinoGrande Challenge, identifying RoBERTa as the previous leading model before T5.

claims.text: The previous state of the art was based on RoBERTa, an encoder-only transformer architecture.
T5-3B surpassed the previous state of the art by over five points in the AI2 WinoGrande Challenge.
The T5 model represents the current state of the art in commonsense reasoning tasks.
